feeds.title: Marc Poulos Painting & Decorating Blog
feeds.description: We are known as professionals who care about detail in beautifying homes as well as customer satisfaction. When you choose us, you choose professional no-hassle painting services providers who will provide you with professional, no-hassle painting services for your home's interior or exterior.

feeds.title: Reliable Home Improvement Blog
feeds.description: Reliable Home Improvement is a full-service home remodeling firm serving the greater Chicagoland area. We specialize in everything from bathroom and kitchen remodeling to designing and building custom home additions. Providing you with full-service remodeling from concept to completion, we eliminate the burden of contracting several vendors for one job.

feeds.title: Normandy Remodeling Blog
feeds.description: Normandy is a design-build remodeler, specializing in home additions and major home remodels. We work with our customers to create conceptual drawings that suit their needs, then we convert them into architectural blueprints, and finally, we build the solution that we planned together.

feeds.title: Orren Pickell Building Group Blog
feeds.description: Founded by Orren Pickell nearly five decades ago, the Orren Pickell Building Group is a custom home builder known throughout Chicago and the North Shore for its unparalleled luxury and attention to detail. They thoughtfully design and build each high-end custom home to suit the homeowners' unique preferences and lifestyles.

feeds.title: Chicago Green Insulation Blog
feeds.description: For more than 11 years, Chicago Green Insulation is a leading installer of spray foam insulation in the Chicagoland area. We are a licensed provider of premium open and closed cell foams and a premier user of PolyMac spray foam equipment.

feeds.title: Benvenuti and Stein Blog
feeds.description: Benvenuti and Stein is a Design-Build firm that also has an In-house Custom Cabinetry shop and has been transforming homes in Chicago and the North Shore since 1977. Offering Design, Construction, and Custom Cabinetry from a single source of allows clients peace of mind knowing that we handle everything from concept to completion. We are recognized for our creative problem-solving, and attention to detail and over the years we have received numerous awards from surrounding communities and have been recognized in national publications.

feeds.title: MK Construction & Building Blog
feeds.description: On MK Construction Blog you can read the latest in construction and remodeling services. MK Construction specializes in designing modern and contemporary homes that are relevant and attuned to Chicago's urban aesthetic and landscape.

feeds.title: Hogan Design & Construction Blog
feeds.description: At Hogan Design & Construction, we use our vision to see the world as it is and as it could be. Our unique and innovative process starts with building strong customer relationships that continue with expectations surpassed.

feeds.title: BDS Design Build Remodel Blog
feeds.description: BDS Design Build Remodel is passionate about designing and remodeling homes that make memories. We are a family-owned company, servicing Chicago's North Shore for nearly 15 years. From kitchen and bathroom remodeling to whole home remodeling, our in-house design team works with you to create and design your vision from the ground up.

feeds.title: Yellow Brick Home
feeds.description: We are a husband and wife duo from Chicago, living, working, and playing in a second-floor walk-up nestled amidst the hustle and bustle. Our goal here is to share our home adventures, (too much of) our 4-legged kiddos, DIY projects, and all those things that go into making a home a home - all the while living in a teeny urban environment.

feeds.title: Patrick A Finn Blog
feeds.description: Patrick A. Finn utilizes a design-build process to deliver flawless design and transform obsolete spaces into beautiful places! We're committed to true craftsmanship and adding value through creativity, foresight, integrity, masterful performance, and honesty.

feeds.title: DIY Playbook Blog
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Casey Finn. I'm the Chicago gal and voice behind The DIY Playbook. I love a good weekend project, and I'm creating my dream home right here in my favorite city. I'm here to inspire you to create the space of your dreams. Together let's build a home that tells your story.

feeds.title: Fix It People Blog
feeds.description: For those working through a list of home-improvement projects, Fix It People is the modern handyman service that does it all delivering reliable craftsmanship to every corner of the home. We're an organized, professional, home-improvement service - with the dotted i's to prove it.

feeds.title: Cabinet Land Blog
feeds.description: We specialize in designing and installing cabinetry for all your needs, from your kitchen to your bathroom to your study. With our wide variety of styles and brands, we will fit your individual needs. Our brands offer a wide variety of cabinets in varying colors, styles, prices, and options.

feeds.title: Stratagem Construction Blog
feeds.description: At Stratagem, we're committed to making our customers happy and keeping them happy during every phase of home remodeling. We do that by mixing outstanding in-house interior design work with thoughtful craftsmanship and excellent customer service.

feeds.title: Homewerks Blog
feeds.description: HomeWerks takes pride in our reputation as one of the finest home renovation companies in the Chicagoland area. Our mission is to provide our customers with excellent, value-laden home renewal products which enhance their home's appeal and functionality. Our team always works tirelessly to satisfy our customers. We believe our standards of quality, integrity, and ethics are unmatched.

feeds.title: Design F1rst Builders Blog
feeds.description: DESIGNfirst Builders was first founded in 2006 to help clients throughout Chicagoland achieve the home of their dreams. With our reputation and many years of experience, we know our team is able to help improve your space to meet all of your expectations.

feeds.title: HMMH Kitchen and Bath Remodeling Blog
feeds.description: With over 20 years of experience, client referrals and word-of-mouth praise drive our company. Whether you are looking to update the look and functionality of your kitchen, bath, or basement, OR, tackle that list of home repairs and improvements, Handy Men & Mrs. Helper Kitchen & Bath is who you can trust to make it happen.

feeds.title: Chi Renovation and Design Blog
feeds.description: We are a full-service, licensed, and bonded design-build company that provides superior remodeling services for kitchens, bathrooms, basements, and all residential renovation needs for our Chicago clientele. With our integrated design-build approach, everything is under control for your project - from design to material procurement, project management to construction - so that your renovation process is smooth and efficient.

feeds.title: Window Works Blog
feeds.description: WindowWorks has been helping homeowners with new windows and doors since 1996. Our goal today remains as it was in the beginning, help homeowners by providing industry-leading products with expert installation at affordable prices.

feeds.title: Darek & Sons Remodeling Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Darek and Sons Remodeling! We are remodeling contractors performing bathroom remodeling, kitchen remodeling, basement remodeling, home additions, and other home remodeling projects. We have been serving the Northern Chicago Suburbs for over 15 years, providing high-quality and affordable work.

feeds.title: The Renovation Sells Blog
feeds.description: Renovation Sells is a construction and design company specializing in renovations that prepare homes to hit the market and sell fast. Our team puts emphasis on design and delivers the look that makes the best first impression with buyers, both online and in person.

feeds.title: Excellent Kitchen Remodeling Blog
feeds.description: EXCELLENT is an experienced company with a group of specialists who provide not only reliable kitchen remodeling, cabinet refinishing, painting and refacing but also other services responding to the customers' needs.

feeds.title: VILLA Bathroom Remodeling Contractors Blog
feeds.description: Trust VILLA Bathroom Remodeling Contractors in Chicagoland to bring your bathroom renovations to life. We rise above all other remodeling companies in Chicago and the suburbs through our dedication to great customer experiences.

feeds.title: Metro Construction & Remodeling Blog
feeds.description: Metro Construction and Remodeling is renowned for the top-quality workmanship we provide each day on every project in which we are invited to participate. With the experience to guide all our bathroom remodeling contractors in Chicago, you can rely on Metro Construction and Remodeling to bring you the finest materials and the top level of detailed work possible.

feeds.title: Sweeten » Chicago
feeds.description: Sweeten is your go-to resource for renovation inspiration, education, budget guidance, and project support from start to finish. The Chicago blog is a collection of Chicago remodeling stories done by Sweeten general contractors. Find expert advice and high-quality photography for inspiration.
